modern_ite.configuration.title: MITE: Modern ITE Gameplay Settings
modern_ite.config.edit.tooltip: Open settings by category; hover over each setting for when it takes effect.
modern_ite.config.scope: Most saved values apply immediately. Initial attributes and random traits affect new mobs; ores affect new chunks; existing cooldowns remain. Singleplayer worlds share this instance's settings. Multiplayer uses the server's settings.
modern_ite.config.server_owned: These gameplay settings were synchronized by the server and are read-only. Ask the server owner to change the server configuration.
modern_ite.config.search: Search setting names, categories or legacy keys…
modern_ite.config.values.count: %s effective settings · Scroll to browse · Hover for defaults
modern_ite.config.player_enchant_defense: Weapon guarding requires enchantment. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.netherrack_damage_limi: First day of netherrack damage. Default: 96.
modern_ite.config.crit_enchantment_chanc: 20 means 20% per level. Total chance is capped at 100%.
modern_ite.config.crit_enchantment_damag: Extra critical damage per level. Default: 0.4.
modern_ite.config.emergency_cooldown_red: Emergency cooldown reduction per extra piece
Emergency cooldown reduction per extra piece. Default: 0.2.
modern_ite.config.conqueror_damage_boost: Conqueror damage per level per prior hit
Extra damage = enchantment rank x this player's prior successful melee hits on the same target x this value. Added to player stepped damage; both share the successful-hit counter.
modern_ite.config.beheading_chance_boost: Extra beheading chance per level. Default: 0.05.
modern_ite.config.mob_spawner_speed_up_w: Nearby players speed up spawners. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.enhance_limit: Special mob health growth day limit
modern_ite.config.enhance_limit.tooltip: Controls only species-specific health curves over world days. Attack uses the original day-one value, and saved legacy date-scaled attack is normalized. General MITE health growth uses the base mod settings.
modern_ite.config.compressed_skeleton.to: Give all skeleton types a 3% chance to split into miniature skeletons of the same type on death. Offspring cannot split again and obey support and local population limits. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.compressed_skeleton_cr: Duration of weakness, slowness and resistance on newly split miniature skeletons. Default: 20 ticks.
modern_ite.config.compressed_skeleton_ex: Randomly choose this count plus or minus one, clamped to 1–64. Default: 7 (6–8 offspring); 0 disables splitting. Support and local population limits still apply.
modern_ite.config.skeleton_force_melee_a: Allow forced skeleton melee. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.bone_lord_and_longdead: Longdead and bone lord weapon swap chance
Longdead and bone lord weapon swap chance. Default: 0.25.
modern_ite.config.bat_poison_attack.tool: Vampire bat poison attacks. Default: true.
Allow pigmen to use bows. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.zombie_pigman_boost_ch: Elite pigman chance for newly rolled traits. Default: 0.025. Strength level stays fixed; effect duration and Speed retain their day progression.
Overworld ghast fireball power multiplier. Default: 1.25.
modern_ite.config.wolves_attack_players_: Wild wolves target players holding meat
Wild wolves target players holding meat. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.can_boost_iron_golem.t: Disabling suspends existing +20 health, +3 attack and enlarged size. Reenabling restores the bonuses without healing.
modern_ite.config.ender_dragon_immune_to: Dragon arrow immunity health fraction. Default: 0.3.
modern_ite.config.ender_dragon_attack_sl: Dragon attacks inflict slowness. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.nether_mod_attack_fire: Nether mob attack ignition chance. Default: 0.5.
First overworld ghast natural-spawn day, default 128. Blood-moon night, space and other species conditions still apply.
modern_ite.config.annihilation_skeleton_: Allow lit overworld annihilation skeleton spawns
Allow lit overworld annihilation skeleton natural spawns. Off retains the species light check; date, space and other conditions still apply.
modern_ite.config.wandering_witch_spawn_: Overworld wandering witch natural-spawn pass chance, default 33%. 0 disables natural spawns; 100 skips this chance check. Dates and other conditions still apply.

modern_ite.config.nether_adamantium_max_: Nether adamantium vein attempts per chunk
Nether adamantium vein attempts per chunk. Default: 4.
modern_ite.config.stepped_mob_damage_fac: Extra damage equals this mob's prior successful hits on the player times min(maximum factor, fixed factor), independent of world day. Default: 0.5.
modern_ite.config.stepped_mob_damage_pro: Maximum mob repeated-hit damage factor. Default: 2.
Retained for existing configuration compatibility. Date-based repeated-hit damage growth was removed, so this value no longer affects damage.
modern_ite.config.stepped_player_damage_: Maximum unenchanted player repeated-hit bonus. Default: 2.

modern_ite.config.player_disarm_player.t: Players can disarm players. Default: true.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_max_hostile: Default 2. Multiplies only the chunk allowance, not the date allowance. The deep multiplier is applied separately afterward.
modern_ite.config.ancient_bone_lord_spaw: First ancient bone lord automatic spawn day
First ancient bone lord automatic-spawn day, default 192. The extreme monster start day and other species conditions still apply. Eggs and commands are unrestricted.
modern_ite.config.mob_max_spawn_count_in: Hostile allowance added for each displayed current day, default 1. Date limits apply; the blood multiplier does not multiply this part.

modern_ite.config.extreme_mob_spawn_limi: Default day 3; integer range 1–1000000. Each extreme monster automatically spawns from the later of this global limit and its individual day. Global 10 and individual 5 means day 10; individual 15 means day 15. Uses the highest recorded day; dimension and other conditions still apply. Player deaths retain a 5% player-zombie chance exempt from dates and the initial grace period, including direct Black Infernal Creeper explosion deaths. The zombie stores actual death drops on success; otherwise items drop normally. Eggs, commands and existing mobs are unaffected.
modern_ite.config.spawning_rules.tooltip: Edit spawning caps, dates, groups, species chances and splitting/support density using ITE 2.0.28 defaults. Every value is editable and saving takes effect immediately.
modern_ite.config.spawning_live: ITE 2.0.28 defaults; all values are editable and apply on save
modern_ite.config.mob_max_spawn_count_ch: Base allowance per 256 eligible chunks, default 50, plus the date allowance. Blood dates multiply only the chunk part. Shallow and deep counts are independent, with a separate deep multiplier.
modern_ite.config.mob_max_spawn_count_da: Minimum date allowance, default 0. Uses the larger of this value and the current date growth allowance.
Maximum date allowance. Default 0 is unlimited; positive values cap the date part without going below the minimum.
modern_ite.config.local_hostile_limit.to: Splitting and non-encounter support admission cap within 32 blocks horizontally and 8 vertically, default 32. Natural spawning uses separate crowd thresholds. 0 stops these additions without removing mobs.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_local_hosti: Blood-moon splitting and non-encounter support admission cap within 32 blocks horizontally and 8 vertically, default 48. Natural spawning uses separate crowd thresholds. 0 stops these additions.
modern_ite.config.hostile_spawn_groups.t: Ordinary-date groups per eligible chunk each pass, default 3. 0 stops natural attempts without removing existing mobs.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_hostile_spa: Blood-date groups per eligible chunk each pass, default 3. 0 stops natural attempts without removing existing mobs.
modern_ite.config.hostile_spawn_attempts: Natural spawn attempts per group, default 4. 0 stops attempts. Species-specific behavior such as phase spiders is retained; existing mobs are not removed.
modern_ite.config.natural_local_hostile_: Default 8. When nearby mobs exceed the threshold, skip that player’s eligible area. Depth and stronghold adjustments still apply. Separate from splitting/support caps; existing mobs are retained.
modern_ite.config.full_moon_natural_loca: Default 10. On full-moon nights use the larger of this threshold and the depth-adjusted ordinary threshold, then apply the stronghold adjustment. Natural spawning only.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_natural_loc: Default 12. On blood-moon nights use the larger of this threshold and the depth-adjusted ordinary threshold, then apply the stronghold adjustment. Natural spawning only.
modern_ite.config.deep_hostile_cap_multi: Default 2. The independently counted deep cap is the chunk allowance plus date allowance, multiplied by this value. 0 stops deep natural additions without removing mobs.
modern_ite.config.hostile_spawn_interval: Default 1; range 1–72000. Each scheduled pass still checks band probability, random pacing and crowding. Larger intervals reduce refresh frequency.
modern_ite.config.deep_spawn_chance_perc: Default 10%. Checked after scheduling; random pacing, crowding and species conditions still apply. 0 stops deep natural attempts.
modern_ite.config.surface_spawn_chance_p: Default 17%. Checked after scheduling; random pacing, crowding and species conditions still apply. 0 stops surface natural attempts.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_spawn_chanc: Default 1. Multiplies each band’s pass chance, capped at 100%. Does not change groups per pass or caps.
modern_ite.config.other_dimension_spawn_: Default 0.25. Multiplies band pass chances outside the Overworld, capped at 100%. 0 stops natural attempts in those dimensions.
modern_ite.config.monster_spawns.tooltip: Edit natural candidate weights directly, allowing finite decimals from 0 to 1000000. Saved edits apply immediately. Editing or resetting an entity clears its old percentage multiplier; 0 removes the candidate family. Existing entry, day, dimension and population restrictions remain.
Entries use modern_ite:entity_id=weight, allowing finite decimals such as 2.5 from 0 to 1000000. Omitted entries keep each pool's original weight, then natural spawn rates multiply it. 0 removes the candidate family and its replacements. Does not create missing boss entries or bypass a legacy spawn_frequency of 0.
modern_ite.config.natural_spawn_rates.to: Entries use modern_ite:entity_id=multiplier, from 0 to 100. 1 preserves the existing rate; 0 disables natural spawning only. Omitted entities keep their defaults; unknown ITE IDs are retained. Use the dedicated spawn-rate screen to edit these values.
modern_ite.config.spawning_invalid: Enter a valid value within the allowed range
modern_ite.config.mob_spawner_extra_dela: Extra cooldown ticks removed each tick when nearby-player acceleration is enabled. Default 2; 0 uses native speed. Active countdowns respond immediately.
modern_ite.config.blood_moon_hostile_spa: Blood moon spawn groups per chunk
